seo.defaults_hint: Used on pages that do not have their own description or sharing image.
seo.description_hint: One or two sentences, 120–160 characters, saying who you help and how.
seo.og_image_hint: Shown when a link is shared on WhatsApp, Facebook, LinkedIn or X. 1200 × 630 px.
seo.verification_hint: Paste the verification code (or the whole meta tag) given by each search engine when you add the site.
seo.google_hint: Search Console → Add property → URL prefix → HTML tag.
seo.bing_hint: Bing Webmaster Tools → Add site → HTML meta tag (or import from Search Console).
seo.sitemap_is: Submit this sitemap in both consoles:
seo.ai_hint: Assistants such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot and Google AI Overviews answer questions from websites they can read. Allowing answer engines lets them recommend and link to GEC; training crawlers only collect text for future models.
seo.ai_answers: Allow AI answer engines to read the public website
seo.llms_hint: A plain-text summary of GEC, destinations, universities, programs, scholarships and FAQs that AI assistants can read in one request. Updated automatically.
seo.robots_extra_hint: Optional. Only User-agent, Allow, Disallow, Crawl-delay and comment lines are kept.
seo.audit_lead: What to fix so search engines and AI assistants find, understand and recommend the website.
seo.score_good: In good shape. Keep adding content and answering common questions.
seo.score_ok: Good start — fix the warnings below to rank and be cited more often.
seo.score_low: Important basics are missing. Start with the site checks.
seo.tool_bing: also feeds ChatGPT search and Copilot

check.site_description_t: No default description in both languages
check.site_description_d: Add it in Settings → SEO & AI search.
check.site_og_image_d: Links shared on social media and WhatsApp show no picture.
check.site_google_d: Verify the site and submit the sitemap to see how Google indexes it.
check.site_bing_d: Bing's index powers ChatGPT search and Microsoft Copilot answers.
check.site_ai_blocked_d: ChatGPT, Perplexity and Claude cannot read or recommend the site.
check.site_llms_off_d: AI assistants have no quick summary of the site.
check.site_few_faqs_d: Short question-and-answer content is what AI answers and Google's 'People also ask' quote. Aim for 20+.
check.site_no_https_t: The site address is not HTTPS
check.site_no_https_d: Set APP_URL to the https:// address before going live.

issue.uni_no_photo: {n} universities still use the generated picture

seo.geo_title: How to be recommended by AI assistants
seo.geo_lead: Generative engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude) cite pages that answer a question clearly and that other sites trust.
seo.geo_1: Answer real student questions in full sentences: fees, deadlines, entry requirements, visa steps — on the program, university and destination pages.
seo.geo_2: Publish FAQs in Arabic and English (you have {n}); they are marked up as FAQPage for search and AI answers.
seo.geo_3: Keep facts current (tuition, intakes, deadlines) — partner universities can now update their own pages.
seo.geo_4: Get mentioned: university partner pages, student reviews, Google Business Profile, LinkedIn and local press.
seo.geo_5: Write guides that target questions such as “study in the UK with a 70% average” or “cheapest master’s in Germany for Jordanians”.
